A visible limitation

Notes clarify scope without hiding important context.

Scroll navigation material

HomeExploreBuildsAbout

The 356 × 52 glass material uses the same centered link spacing as the top header. It appears near the end of the desktop Earth descent, or forms around the existing links on inner pages after scrolling. Its current-page capsule briefly slides to a clicked route before navigation. Mobile keeps the full-screen menu without a glass pill.

Form demonstrations — no data is submitted or saved.

Demo only. Nothing is saved.

Enter a complete email address.

Field({ id: 'email', label: 'Email', type: 'email', required: true })

Fields include real labels, native validation, helper text, error associations, and disabled states. IDs must be unique on each page. Connect data handling when a real form is added.

What is included?

Logo, brand links, navigation, button variants, glass cards, badges, fields, disclosures, sections, and responsive layout utilities.

How do I add a section?

Compose a Section with Cards and Buttons in a page module, then run the build. Use ui-stack, ui-cluster, and ui-grid for spacing and layout.

One system. More possibilities.

Author pages in src/pages. Import components from src/ui/components.mjs. Typography and theme values live in src/styles/tokens.css; the homepage hero alone uses EB Garamond. Other headings, text, and controls use Geist.

import { Section, Card, Button } from '../ui/components.mjs';

Section({
  id: 'next',
  title: 'Your next idea',
  children: Card({
    variant: 'solid',
    children: Button({ label: 'Explore', href: '/explore/' })
  })
});

Run npm run build to generate the site; npm test checks the component contracts. No framework or package installation is required. HTML children are trusted author content; escape external text before embedding it.
